appTitle.description: The app name displayed as the main heading on the login screen

signInHint.description: Accessibility hint describing what the sign-in button does

signInError.description: Alert message shown when Google sign-in fails

signInAccountConflict.description: Alert message shown when sign-in is refused because the Google account's email already belongs to a different account (HTTP 409 account_conflict)

signInUnavailable.description: Inline error shown on the login screen when Google sign-in cannot start (network or discovery failure)

signInRetry.description: Button label to retry Google sign-in after an error
